notes: stage 3 identification of mg90-d on dev-v006-2A-D, no capture of its own: the README's one-pass identification cut from the committed stage 3 datasets and reduced the way a user's tool would, on 5 V, with no meter, camera, lock or second rail. Step 1: resistance/stop-1 chains 0-3 (24, 36, 24 % x 300 ms into the stops), each step's mean from 2 ms into the held duty, the two 24 % steps' mean against the 36 % step as a two-point line per chain, mean and se over the chains; constructions A as read, B with stage 1's edge lags at 5 V and the brake loop, C adds g (1 - D) V_on off the current with the type's spinning g or the resistance result's meter_g_ms. Step 2: inductance/stop-6 g1-g4 bursts 1-3, oscnb.bursts.period_table with stage 1's lags and no edge fold, the inductance notebook's period fit over the window scale k, mean and se over bursts. Step 3: ladder/low-1 (5 V 8 %), ladder/capture-1 (5 V 15, 30, 60 %), run-up/runup-open-1 (100 %); Ke by bemf-coast's 10 ms window on the coast with the ladder's gate (decel <= 0.35, >= 4 cycles); X = V - Ke w - R i under C with the pass's own R and Ke, rung means interpolated to the knots. Floor from the 5 V holds, turning when the pot slope over the last 400 ms and the coast's early EMF both read over 1 rev/s; value the logistic midpoint clipped to the bracket, bounds never and always turned. Pot speeds nominal (the registry's counts/deg) or through the pot-table's counts-to-degrees map over the window's span, never its local_scale column. Cost from the runner's timestamps; revs by the pot through the map, coasts by the EMF over the ladder's Ke. Repeatability over the ref and run-up brackets of sittings 1, 6 and 7. Grades: gap_sigma the pass less the long-form over the two se in quadrature (half the bracket where the long-form carries a range); under 2 sigma reproduces. The *_long, *_used and *_quoted keys are the named results' own entries, quoted. k_d is not identified by the pass; the dropout reference is the last 20 ms of the 100 % run-ups.
